uniqueness_proof: Hard-region premise m>=5 gives m=5 and hence L=27.

degree3_boundary.statement: In the unique r=9,m=5,L=27 cell, either some live variable has incidence degree <=2 and the existing low-incidence corridor applies, or all nine live variables have incidence degree exactly 3.
proof: Every live variable has positive integer incidence degree and the sum of all nine degrees is L=27.
If no degree<=2 variable exists then every degree is at least 3.
Nine integers each at least 3 summing to 27 must all equal exactly 3.

degree3_raw_bound.statement: If all pivot incidences equal 3, every ordinary pivot is raw-cap safe. Pure pivots are deletion-only. A mixed pivot has polarity bucket sizes {1,2}; the existing generic raw bound gives B_x<=37.
proof: Assume p=1,q=2 without loss of generality. The existing whole-state bound becomes B_x=s+2-2-4+(2-1)U_plus+(1-1)U_minus=s-4+U_plus.
The + bucket has exactly one clause. Its nonpivot tail contains at most the other r-1=8 live variables, so U_plus<=8.
The p=2,q=1 case is symmetric. Pure p=3,q=0 or p=0,q=3 pivots create no cross resolvents and are deletion-only.
Thus every pivot has an exact raw-cap-safe elimination under cap 1764.

theorem.name: NO_RAW_CAP_RESCUE_REQUIRED_THROUGH_N42
theorem.statement: Inherit N<=41. At N=42 all roots except the unique hard cell r=9,m=5,L=27 are covered by previously proved small-clause, low-incidence reroot, or T/Smax/Uraw corridors. In the unique cell, either a degree<=2 pivot invokes the existing low-incidence corridor or all pivots have incidence exactly 3; then the existing generic raw bound certifies every pivot with B_x<=37. From the resulting n<=8,s<=37 state, the existing recurrence remains below the original 42^2 cap through the exact terminal lanes. Thus no legitimate N<=42 root requires v2/v3 because of ordinary raw-cap unavailability.
